name: Jair
overview: Jair is a notable figure in Scripture known primarily as the son of Manasseh who established numerous towns in the region of Gilead, calling them Havothjair or the villages of Jair. He is also recognized as a judge of Israel who led the nation for twenty-two years, demonstrating leadership during a critical period. Additionally, Jair is identified as a Benjamite and the father of Elhanan, connecting him to broader tribal and familial lines within Israel. His legacy includes both territorial influence through city founding and spiritual leadership as a judge.
